items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: And I have made some recordings for, on a banjo and some recordings on, with the piano and with, what do you call it, with Kent? The brother used to, with Mills.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never knew you played banjo.
And I have made some recordings for, on a banjo and some recordings on, with the piano and with, what do you call it, with Kent? The brother used to, with Mills.
With Mills. Yeah, yeah. That's the first time I heard you play banjo. I believe that you did.
